mock_data.title: A Grim Discovery
mock_data.passage:
A report in the local newspaper of the discovery of an unidentified corpse.

The town of Springford woke to some shocking news yesterday. Police revealed that the body of a young woman had been found in a wooded area just outside the town. The person who made the grim discovery was 46-year-old Jim Bradley, who was walking his dog at the time.

He told our reporter earlier today, 'The dog's very well trained and usually he stays close to me, but on Thursday morning he went off like the clappers into the undergrowth. I could hear him, but I couldn't see him. I wasn't best pleased because I had intended staying on the path and wasn't wearing the right footwear for tramping through the undergrowth. When I eventually reached the dog I couldn't believe my eyes. He was scrabbling away at something buried in the ground and there was a human arm sticking out. I thought I was seeing things. I moved forward to take a closer look and saw that the dog was in the process of uncovering a dead body.

'I put the dog's leash on him and pulled him away before calling the police on my mobile. I wanted to get out of there right away, but the police asked me to stay where I was until they arrived. I wasn't at all happy about staying there, I can tell you, but I had no choice but to sweat it out until the police arrived. The dog had the wind up as well and was whimpering and shivering at my feet. Fortunately, the police were quick off the mark and were with me very quickly.

'My heart goes out to the relatives of that poor young woman, but I just want to try and put the whole thing to the back of my mind, although I doubt if that will be possible. I'm sure that I'll be having nightmares about this for the rest of my life.'

Meanwhile Detective Inspector Tony Miles said that there was very little that he could tell us at this stage. 'It's early days in the investigation, but we will be pulling out all the stops to find out who did this terrible thing to the young woman. As yet, we cannot reveal her identity, as her next of kin have not yet been informed. We will keep you informed of developments as they arise. Meanwhile, we would ask the public to try and stay calm.'

The town of Springford had some bad news yesterday. The police said they found the body of a young woman. It was in a forest area just outside the town. A man called Jim Bradley, who is 46 years old, found the body. He was walking his dog.

He told our reporter, 'My dog is usually good and stays near me. But on Thursday morning, he ran quickly into the bushes. I could hear him, but I couldn't see him. I wasn't happy because I wanted to stay on the path. I didn't have the right shoes for walking through the bushes. When I finally got to the dog, I couldn't believe what I saw. He was digging at something in the ground. I saw a human arm sticking out. I thought I was imagining things. I went closer and saw that the dog was uncovering a dead body.'

'I put the dog on his leash and pulled him away. Then I called the police on my phone. I wanted to leave right away, but the police asked me to stay there until they came. I didn't want to stay there at all, but I had to wait until the police arrived. The dog was also scared and was making quiet, sad sounds and shaking at my feet. Luckily, the police came very quickly.'

'I feel very sorry for the family of that young woman. I just want to try and forget about the whole thing, but I don't think that will be possible. I think I will have nightmares about this for a long time.'

Detective Inspector Tony Miles said he couldn't tell us much yet. 'It's early in the investigation. We will do everything we can to find out who did this terrible thing to the young woman. We can't say who she is yet because we haven't told her family. We will tell you more when we know more. Please, everyone, try to remain calm.'

The police are asking anyone who has any information to contact them. They hope to identify the young woman soon and find out what happened to her.
mock_data.passageB2:
The town of Springford was shaken yesterday by the discovery of a body just outside of town. Police have confirmed that the body of a young woman was found in a wooded area. The unfortunate individual who made the discovery was Jim Bradley, a 46-year-old local resident, who was walking his dog.

Mr. Bradley spoke to our reporter earlier today, describing the sequence of events. 'Normally, my dog stays right by my side, he's very well-behaved. But yesterday morning, he suddenly took off into the bushes at high speed. I could hear him crashing around, but I couldn't see him. I wasn't too happy, as I was planning on sticking to the path and wasn't wearing suitable shoes for trekking through the undergrowth. When I finally caught up with him, I was completely stunned. He was digging at something in the ground, and I saw what looked like a human arm sticking out. At first, I thought I was imagining things. But when I got closer, I realised he was unearthing a dead body.'

'I immediately put the dog on his leash and pulled him away from the scene before calling the police. I wanted to get out of there as quickly as possible, but the police asked me to remain until they arrived. I wasn't thrilled about staying, I can tell you, but I had no choice but to wait it out until they got there. The dog was clearly distressed, whimpering and shivering at my feet. Thankfully, the police responded promptly and arrived very quickly.'

'My heart goes out to the family of that poor young woman. I'm trying to block it out, but I don't think I'll be able to. I'm sure I'll be having nightmares about this for a long time,' he added.

Detective Inspector Tony Miles stated that he could only release limited information at this stage. 'The investigation is in its initial stages, but we are doing everything we can to find out who committed this terrible crime. We cannot release the victim's identity yet, as we have not yet notified her next of kin. We will update the public with any significant developments as they happen. In the meantime, we ask everyone to remain calm and refrain from speculation.'
mock_data.passageC1:
Springford residents were jolted awake yesterday by the unsettling news that an unidentified female corpse had been discovered just beyond the town's periphery. The grim find was made by Jim Bradley, a 46-year-old local, while he was exercising his dog in a nearby wooded area.

Speaking to our reporter earlier today, a visibly shaken Mr. Bradley recounted the harrowing experience. 'Normally, my dog is exceptionally well-behaved and stays within close proximity. However, on Thursday morning, he suddenly bolted off into the dense undergrowth with unexpected alacrity. Although I could hear him, my line of sight was completely obstructed. I was, to put it mildly, displeased, as I had intended to adhere to the designated path and was, frankly, ill-equipped for traversing such terrain. Upon finally reaching him, I was met with a scene that was, quite frankly, unbelievable. He was frantically digging at something partially buried, and I could discern what appeared to be a human arm protruding from the earth. Initially, I questioned my own perception, but upon closer inspection, it dawned on me that he was in the process of unearthing a deceased individual.

'I immediately secured his leash and physically restrained him before contacting the authorities via my mobile phone. My immediate instinct was to remove myself from the scene as swiftly as possible, but the police requested that I remain in situ until their arrival. Needless to say, I was far from comfortable with this proposition, and I was left with no option but to endure the wait until they arrived. The dog, understandably, was also deeply distressed, exhibiting signs of extreme anxiety, whimpering and shivering at my feet. Fortunately, the police responded with commendable speed and were on the scene expeditiously.

'My deepest sympathies are extended to the family of this unfortunate young woman. As for myself, I am attempting to compartmentalize this entire episode and relegate it to the recesses of my mind, although I concede that this may prove to be an insurmountable task. I fully anticipate that I will be plagued by nightmares as a consequence of this experience for the foreseeable future.'

Detective Inspector Tony Miles, when approached for comment, stated that he was severely limited in what he could divulge at this juncture. 'The investigation is in its nascent stages, but we are leaving no stone unturned in our efforts to identify the perpetrator(s) responsible for this heinous act. At present, we are unable to disclose the victim's identity, as her next of kin have yet to be notified. We will, of course, keep the public apprised of any significant developments as they come to light. In the meantime, we urge everyone to remain calm and refrain from speculation that could impede the investigation.'

mock_data.translation:
Mahalliy gazetada noma'lum jasad topilishi haqidagi xabar.

Springford shahri kecha dahshatli yangiliklar bilan uyg'ondi. Politsiya yosh ayolning jasadi shahar tashqarisidagi o'rmonli hududda topilganini ma'lum qildi. Bu dahshatli topilmani amalga oshirgan 46 yoshli Jim Bredli bo'lib, u o'sha paytda itini sayr qildirmoqda edi.

U bugun ertaroq bizning muxbirimizga shunday dedi: "It juda yaxshi o'qitilgan va odatda u menga yaqin turadi, lekin payshanba kuni ertalab u o't-o'lanlar orasiga juda tez yugurdi. Men uni eshitardim, lekin ko'ra olmadim. Men juda xafa bo'ldim, chunki men yo'lda qolishni mo'ljallagandim va o't-o'lanlar orasidan yurishga mos oyoq kiyimi yo'q edi. Oxir-oqibat itga yetganimda ko'zimga ishonolmadim. U yerga ko'milgan narsani tirnalab yotgan edi va yerdan odam qo'li chiqib turardi. Men ko'z aldanayotgan bo'lsa kerak deb o'yladim. Yaqinroq ko'rish uchun oldinga yurdim va itning jasadni ochish jarayonida ekanligini ko'rdim.

"Men itning tasmasini unga taqib, uni tortib olib ketdim va keyin mobil telefonimdan politsiyaga qo'ng'iroq qildim. Men u yerdan darhol ketishni xohlardim, lekin politsiya menga ular kelguncha u yerda qolishni so'radi. Men u yerda qolishdan umuman mamnun emasdim, lekin politsiya kelguncha kutishdan boshqa ilojim yo'q edi. It ham qo'rqib ketgan edi va oyoqlarim ostida titrardi. Xayriyatki, politsiya juda tez keldi.

"O'sha bechora yosh ayolning qarindoshlariga hamdardlik bildiraman, lekin men butun ishni unutishga harakat qilmoqchiman, garchi bu mumkin emasligiga ishonchim komil. Men butun umrim davomida bu haqda tushlarimda ko'rishimga aminman."

Shu orada Detektiv Inspektor Toni Maylz bu bosqichda bizga aytadigan narsa juda kam ekanini aytdi. "Tergov endi boshlangan, lekin biz bu yosh ayolga bu dahshatli ishni kim qilganini aniqlash uchun barcha kuchimizni sarflaymiz. Hozircha uning kimligini oshkor eta olmaymiz, chunki uning eng yaqin qarindoshlariga hali xabar berilmagan. Biz sizni rivojlanishlar haqida xabardor qilib boramiz. Shu orada, biz jamoatchilikdan sokin bo'lishni so'raymiz."

Springford shahrida kecha yomon xabar tarqaldi. Politsiya yosh ayolning jasadini topganini ma'lum qildi. U shahar tashqarisidagi o'rmon hududida edi. Jim Bredli ismli 46 yoshli erkak jasadni topdi. U iti bilan sayr qilayotgan edi.

U bizning muxbirimizga shunday dedi: 'Itim odatda yaxshi, yonimda yuradi. Ammo payshanba kuni ertalab u tezda butazorlar ichiga yugurdi. Uni eshitdim, lekin ko'ra olmadim. Men xursand emas edim, chunki yo'lda qolishni xohlardim. Butazorlar ichida yurish uchun to'g'ri poyabzalim yo'q edi. Nihoyat itimga yetganimda, ko'zlarimga ishonmadim. U yerda nimadir qaziyotgan edi. Men insonning qo'li chiqib turganini ko'rdim. O'yladimki, men xayol suryapman. Yaqinroq bordim va it o'lik jasadni ochayotganini ko'rdim.'

'Itimni bog'ichga bog'lab, uni tortib oldim. Keyin telefonim orqali politsiyaga qo'ng'iroq qildim. Men darhol ketmoqchi edim, lekin politsiya kelguniga qadar u yerda qolishimni so'radi. Men u yerda umuman qolishni xohlamadim, lekin politsiya kelguniga qadar kutishim kerak edi. It ham qo'rqqan edi va oyoqlarim ostida jim, qayg'uli tovushlar chiqarib, titrayotgan edi. Yaxshiyamki, politsiya juda tez keldi.'

'Men o'sha yosh ayolning oilasiga juda achinaman. Men shunchaki butun narsani unutishga harakat qilmoqchiman, lekin bu mumkin bo'ladi deb o'ylamayman. Men bu haqda uzoq vaqt davomida dahshatli tushlar ko'raman deb o'ylayman.'

Detektiv inspektor Toni Mayls hali ko'p narsa ayta olmasligini aytdi. 'Bu tergovning boshlanishi. Biz bu yosh ayolga bu dahshatli ishni kim qilganini aniqlash uchun qo'limizdan kelganicha harakat qilamiz. Biz uning oilasiga aytmaganimiz uchun hali kimligini ayta olmaymiz. Ko'proq bilganimizda sizga ko'proq ma'lumot beramiz. Iltimos, hammangiz xotirjam bo'lishga harakat qiling.'

Politsiya har qanday ma'lumotga ega bo'lganlardan ular bilan bog'lanishni so'ramoqda. Ular tez orada yosh ayolni aniqlashga va unga nima bo'lganini bilishga umid qilishmoqda.

Janob Bredli bugun ertalab bizning muxbirimizga bo'lgan voqealar ketma-ketligini aytib berdi. 'Odatda, itim yonimda yuradi, u juda itoatkor. Ammo kecha ertalab u to'satdan katta tezlikda butalar orasiga yugurib ketdi. Uning shovqinini eshitdim, lekin uni ko'rmadim. Men unchalik xursand bo'lmadim, chunki men yo'ldan chiqmaslikni rejalashtirgandim va sayohat qilish uchun mos poyabzal kiymagandim. Nihoyat unga yetib olganimda, men butunlay hayratda qoldim. U yerda nimadir qaziyotgan edi va men yerga qadalgan odamning qo'liga o'xshash narsani ko'rdim. Avvaliga, men tasavvur qilayotgandek tuyuldi. Ammo yaqinroq borgach, u o'lik jasadni qazib olayotganini angladim.'

'Men darhol itimga bog'ich taqib, uni voqea joyidan olib tashladim, so'ngra politsiyaga qo'ng'iroq qildim. Men u yerdan iloji boricha tezroq qochib ketmoqchi edim, lekin politsiya menga ular kelguncha qolishimni so'radi. Qolishdan xursand emasdim, aytishim mumkin, lekin ular kelguncha kutib turishdan boshqa ilojim yo'q edi. Itim aniq xavotirda edi, oyoqlarim ostida ingrab, titrab turardi. Yaxshiyamki, politsiya tezda javob berdi va juda tez yetib keldi.'

'Mening yuragim o'sha bechora yosh ayolning oilasi bilan birga. Men buni unutishga harakat qilyapman, lekin o'ylaymanki, bunga erisha olmayman. Ishonchim komilki, bu haqda uzoq vaqt davomida dahshatli tushlar ko'raman', - deb qo'shimcha qildi u.

Detektiv inspektor Toni Maylzning ta'kidlashicha, u hozircha faqat cheklangan ma'lumotlarni e'lon qilishi mumkin. 'Tergov dastlabki bosqichida, lekin biz bu dahshatli jinoyatni kim sodir etganini aniqlash uchun qo'limizdan kelganicha harakat qilyapmiz. Jabrlanuvchining shaxsini hozircha e'lon qila olmaymiz, chunki biz uning eng yaqin qarindoshlariga hali xabar bermadik. Biz har qanday muhim o'zgarishlar haqida jamoatchilikni xabardor qilib boramiz. Shu bilan birga, biz hammadan xotirjam bo'lishni va taxminlardan tiyilishni so'raymiz'.

Спрингфилд аҳолиси кеча шаҳар ташқарисида номаълум аёл жасади топилгани ҳақидаги нохуш хабардан сергак тортишди. Мудҳиш топилма 46 ёшли маҳаллий аҳоли вакили Жим Брэдли томонидан яқин атрофдаги ўрмонда итини сайр қилдираётганда аниқланган.

Бугун эрталаб бизнинг мухбиримизга интервью берган, кўринишидан қаттиқ ҳаяжонланган жаноб Брэдли даҳшатли воқеани ҳикоя қилиб берди. 'Одатда, менинг итим жуда итоаткор ва доимо ёнимда юради. Бироқ, пайшанба куни эрталаб у тўсатдан кутилмаганда ўрмон ичига отилиб кетди. Уни эшитиб турсам ҳам, кўзим билан кўра олмадим. Тўғрисини айтсам, бундан жуда норози бўлдим, чунки белгиланган йўлдан юришни режалаштирган эдим ва бундай жойларда юриш учун етарлича тайёр эмасдим. Ниҳоят унга етганимда, кўзларимга ишонмадим. У ниманидир қисман кўмилган ҳолда қазиётган эди ва мен ердан чиқиб турган инсон қўли эканлигини кўрдим. Аввалига, кўзларимга ишонмадим, лекин яқинроқ қараганимдан кейин, у вазиятни англадим ва у ўлик одамни ковлаётган экан.'

'Мен дарҳол унинг ипини маҳкамладим ва қўлим билан ушлаб турдим, сўнгра мобил телефоним орқали ҳукуматга хабар бердим. Биринчи ўйим воқеа жойидан иложи борича тезроқ кетиш эди, аммо полиция улар келгунига қадар ўша ерда қолишимни сўради. Айтиш керакки, бу таклиф менга умуман ёқмади ва улар келгунига қадар кутишга мажбур бўлдим. Итим ҳам, тушунарлики, жуда хавотирланган эди, ўта ташвиш аломатларини намоён қиларди, оёқларим остида инграб ва титраб турарди. Яхшиямки, полиция тезда етиб келди ва воқеа жойига тезлик билан етиб келди.'

'Марҳум ёш аёлнинг оиласига чуқур таъзиямни билдираман. Ўзимга келсак, мен бутун воқеани тартибга солишга ва онгимнинг энг чекка қисмларига жойлашга ҳаракат қиляпман, гарчи бунинг уддасидан чиқиш жуда қийин бўлиши мумкинлигини тан оламан. Бу воқеа натижасида яқин келажакда даҳшатли тушлар кўришимни кутяпман.'

Детектив инспектор Тони Майлз изоҳ сўралганда, ҳозирги вақтда нимани ошкор қилиши мумкинлиги жуда чекланганини айтди. 'Тергов энди бошланмоқда, аммо биз бу жирканчли ишни содир этган айбдор(лар)ни аниқлаш учун ҳеч нарсани эътибордан четда қолдирмаймиз. Ҳозирги вақтда биз жабрланувчининг шахсини ошкор қила олмаймиз, чунки унинг яқинларига ҳали хабар берилмаган. Албатта, маълумотлар аниқ бўлгани сари биз аҳолини барча муҳим воқеалардан хабардор қилиб турамиз. Шу билан бирга, биз ҳаммани хотиржам бўлишга ва терговга халақит бериши мумкин бўлган тахминлардан тийилишга чақирамиз.'
